text: dsh-extension-manager 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件与技能管理面板，在设置页汇总当前 Profile 中的插件、运行状态、技能来源和工作区技能。它通过 Host API 读取库存、显示诊断与历史，并允许用户刷新清单、检查更新、查看更新计划及执行单项或批量更新。更新过程以后台任务呈现进度，并在 Host 侧记录可恢复的事务状态。适合需要在 DSH 中集中查看和维护扩展及技能的用户；更新检查与下载会访问相应的软件注册表或 GitHub 来源。

dsh-extension-manager adds a plugin and skill manager to DSH Web settings. It shows installed plugins, runtime state, and skills by source. Users can refresh inventories, check updates, review plans, and run individual or batch updates. Tasks report progress; the Host records transaction state.

dsh-extension-manager 的功能「插件库存」：汇总 Profile 已安装组合包、插件运行状态及来源信息。打开设置中的扩展管理器页面即可查看，可刷新列表。
dsh-extension-manager 的功能「技能库存」：扫描可见技能目录并关联运行时技能与来源信息。用户可查看全局或指定已注册工作区的技能清单。
dsh-extension-manager 的功能「检查和执行更新」：用户可检查插件或技能更新、查看更新计划，再启动单项或批量更新任务并查看进度。

A native **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)** plugin that inventories, checks and safely updates the **Plugins** and **Skills** installed on your machine — from one page inside the DSH Web GUI.

dsh-extension-manager README · DSH Extension Manager：It is a real settings section, not a standalone site: **Settings → 扩展管理器 (Extension Manager)**. All data comes from Host-side reads of the plugin manager, the live Skills registry, profile manifests, pnpm lockfiles, npm registries, GitHub and `git ls-remote`. Updates run as durable transactions with verified backups and automatic rollback.

dsh-extension-manager README · Features：- **One page, two inventories.** A segmented **Plugins / Skills** control, three primary stats with expandable details, source groups, search, status/source filters, sorting, workspace-aware Skills scanning, details dialogs and per-record update history.
- **Plugins**: installed third-party bundles, the Loader rows they contribute, runtime loaded/failed state, install spec/version/provenance, and read-only views of other readable profiles. DSH-shipped components are intentionally excluded — DSH's own **Built-in plugins** page manages them.
- **Skills**: physical copies vs. runtime-visible skills, same-name shadowing, unmanaged roots, invocation policy, provenance and local-modification state.
- **Update checks**: npm registry lookup with private-registry isolation and DSH-compatibility evaluation; git installs through `git ls-remote`; Skills through GitHub trees API and `.skill-lock.json` folder hashes. Failures and rate limits are reported, never rendered as “up to date”.
- **Safe updates**: plan → confirm → verified backup → download/stage → install → read-back validation; failures roll back automatically. One update at a time (concurrent r

dsh-extension-manager README · What's new in 0.4.6：Version **0.4.6** is available on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-extension-manager/v/0.4.6) and [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/NewBeeJack/dsh-extension-manager/releases/tag/v0.4.6). This patch hardens the development browser tools; it does not change the plugin's runtime behavior.

dsh-extension-manager README · What's new in 0.4.6：- **Browser ownership checks**: screenshot and dialog-layout tools use separate temporary-profile namespaces, validate profile paths and identify processes by their exact profile directory before cleanup.
- **Verified CDP connections**: the layout tool reads `DevToolsActivePort` from its own profile and verifies the page target before navigation. Shutdown prefers browser-level `Browser.close`, then falls back to cleanup scoped to that profile.
- **Bounded cleanup**: external waits and deletion retries have deadlines; shutdown is idempotent across normal completion and signal handling.
- **Regression coverage**: dedicated browser-lifecycle and layout-guard suites supplement the existing unit tests. Their platform requirements and validation limits are described under [Development](#development).
dsh-extension-manager README · What's new in 0.4.6：See the [release notes](https://github.com/NewBeeJack/dsh-extension-manager/releases/tag/v0.4.6) for the full change list and known limits.

dsh-extension-manager README · UI highlights carried forward from 0.4.5：- **V3 visual refresh**: soft semantic stat cards, real package icons with a local network-node default for Plugins and a document fallback for Skills, three-layer extension cards with full install-directory copy, compact check-result summary with partial-failure warning, header diagnostics and a measured single-row toolbar.
- **V2.1 fixes**: Plugins and Skills each own their task result panel, details-expanded state and dismissed state; group headers remain collapsible with filters/sorting; list rows keep only one “view details” arrow (details and batch update retain the existing actions).
- **Toolbar V2**: search, filter, refresh-list, check-updates and the conditional black update-all are measured against the real content width; they stay on one line when their natural widths fit, keep labels unwrapped and use a common 34 px control height. The update-all count comes from the existing read-only batch plan, and the button stays hidden until a complete successful check.

dsh-extension-manager README · From npm (recommended)：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-extension-manager@0.4.6
```

Omit `@0.4.6` to install the version tagged `latest` on your configured registry.

dsh-extension-manager README · From a release tarball：Download `dsh-extension-manager-0.4.6.tgz` and `SHA256SUMS` from the [GitHub Release](https://github.com/NewBeeJack/dsh-extension-manager/releases/tag/v0.4.6). Verify the archive against `SHA256SUMS` before installing it (`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`, or `Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 <path-to-tarball>` in PowerShell and compare the hash).

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "<absolute path>/dsh-extension-manager-0.4.6.tgz"
```

dsh-extension-manager README · Enable the bundle：After either installation method, enable the bundle. `dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm and does **not** select the bundle, so add `"dsh-extension-manager"` to the existing `dsh.profile.bundles` array in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json`, or enable it from the DSH plugin manager UI. Preserve the other bundle entries. Restart DSH (or let HMR recompose the profile). Open **Settings → 扩展管理器**.

dsh-extension-manager README · Upgrade the manager：The manager excludes itself from in-page update checks and updates, including when installed from npm. To upgrade to this release, run the npm or tarball installation command above for the same profile, then restart DSH. Publishing to npm does not enable in-page self-update.

dsh-extension-manager README · Build from source：Use tag `v0.4.6` for the released source, or `maintenance/0.4.x` for ongoing maintenance. From the repository root:

```bash
npm ci
npm run build          # lib/index.js (Host ESM) + lib/client.js (Web client)
npm test               # 131 unit tests
npm pack               # dsh-extension-manager-<package.json version>.tgz

dsh-extension-manager README · Build from source：Then install the packed tarball as above. For iterative development use `dsh plugin --profile web add "link:<path-to-checkout>"` and rebuild; the client bundle hot-swaps and `node scripts/dev/reload-host.mjs` can trigger a Host recomposition.

dsh-extension-manager README · Using the page：Open **Settings → 扩展管理器**. The toolbar provides search, source/status/range filters, a Skills workspace picker, refresh, diagnostics, **check all updates** and **update all safe updates (N)**.

dsh-extension-manager README · Using the page：- **Check** is per item or batch; results are cached for 5 minutes and recorded in `state.json`.
- **Update** always builds a plan first. Batch mode only auto-runs safe entries; items with local modifications, prerelease-only or git sources are listed for explicit per-item confirmation (with a risk checkbox and optional overwrite confirmation).
- The task panel streams progress; when a restart is required the page shows a pending-restart banner.
- Everything writable is addressed by inventory id and resolved server-side; client-supplied paths are never trusted.

dsh-extension-manager README · Update safety：```
PREFLIGHT → BACKUP → DOWNLOAD → STAGE → INSTALL → VALIDATE → PENDING_RESTART / VERIFIED
failures: FAILED → RECOVERY → RECOVERED / RECOVERY_REQUIRED
```

dsh-extension-manager README · Update safety：- The install directory plus profile manifests (`package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `compatibility.json`) are hash-verified before any destructive step.
- Validation reads `listBundles()` back and checks the lockfile commit; a zero exit code alone is not success.
- Backups live under `$DSH_HOME/extension-manager/backups/<txid>/`; the newest 20 transactions are kept (open transactions are never pruned). Logs are JSON Lines with credential masking.
- The manager never updates itself, never restarts DSH, and never writes to other profiles. DSH-shipped components are not listed or updated here; use DSH's **Built-in plugins** page for those.

dsh-extension-manager README · Compatibility and limitations：- Baseline: **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**. Uses `ctx.pluginManager`, `ctx.skills`, `ctx.webServer`, `profileContext`, `ctx.connection.admit`, optional `loader`/`configEditor`/`workspaceRegistry`/`hmr`.
- Other profiles are read-only. DSH-shipped components are excluded from this page and follow the DSH release (manage them in **Built-in plugins**).
- Git-installed plugin updates are single-item, explicitly confirmed, and cannot fully roll back install-script side effects.
- Skills auto-update supports GitHub-backed directory skills only; flat-file skills and directories containing symlinks are refused.
- No per-skill enable/disable (DSH has no such mechanism), no in-page self-update, no DSH restart from the page, no “cancel running update” button.
- Verified on Windows; POSIX code paths exist but are untested.
dsh-extension-manager README · Compatibility and limitations：The full limitation list and detailed rules are in [README.zh.md](README.zh.md) §9 (Chinese; a complete user/maintenance guide).

dsh-extension-manager README · Development：```bash
npm ci
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build

The commands below require a source checkout; development scripts are not included in the npm package.

- `test/*.test.ts` — 131 unit tests (native Node TS runner, no build step): registry/git/lockfile parsing, compatibility, transaction state machine, backups, archive extraction, rollback and crash recovery.
- **Browser lifecycle regressions** (separate from `npm test`):

dsh-extension-manager README · Development：The lifecycle suite has 18 cases and requires Windows plus an installed Edge or Chrome browser (`npm run test:lifecycle -- --browser <path>` selects the executable). On other platforms it reports a skip; exit code 0 alone does not mean the cases ran. The layout-guard suite has 55 cases covering endpoint ownership, timeouts, identity refusal and launch arguments. These suites do not replace a full real-browser isolation check.

dsh-extension-manager README · Development：The recorded real-Edge isolation check covers Edge 155.0.4283.62 on one Windows account. It was not rerun for the 0.4.6 release. The PID-reuse window is narrowed, not eliminated; elevated/unelevated restart scenarios remain untested.
- **Isolated acceptance environment** (never touches your real `~/.dsh` / `~/.agents`):

dsh-extension-manager README · Development：```bash
  node scripts/test-env/setup.mjs [root]
  node scripts/test-env/start.mjs --port 3099 [--root <root>]
  node scripts/test-env/run-all.mjs
  node scripts/test-env/stop.mjs

The scenarios cover npm/git/Skills updates, rollback, local-modification conflicts, batch/concurrency, interrupted-install recovery and Windows file locks.
- **Dialog layout regression** (CDP, headless Chrome by default; use `--chrome <path>` for Edge):

dsh-extension-manager README · Development：```bash
  node scripts/dev/verify-dialog-layout.mjs --url "http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=..." \
    --sizes "1920x1080,1536x864,1366x768,1093x614,911x512,683x384"
  ```

dsh-extension-manager README · Development：Replace the placeholder with a fresh DSH token URL. `--cookie <cookie.json>` is optional when using a token URL. Keep token URLs and cookie files private. It opens every dialog, asserts 24px/24px top/bottom spacing, no footer overlap, scrollable body with a readable last line, multiple viewport sizes and dark mode. See [docs/dialog-layout.md](https://github.com/NewBeeJack/dsh-extension-manager/blob/maintenance/0.4.x/docs/dialog-layout.md).
